slip.document:
# Ironwood Adjusting Journal Entries — December 2025
Ironwood Fabrication LLC | Close date: 12/31/2025 | Prepared by Samuel Nguyen | Reviewed by Naomi Hendricks

## Supporting records
| Item | Supporting detail |
| --- | --- |
| Insurance policy | $12,000 paid 10/01/2025; 12-month term ends 09/30/2026 |
| Software subscription | $600 paid 12/01/2025; coverage runs 01/01/2026–12/31/2026 |
| Customer advance | $18,000 received 12/20/2025; fabrication and delivery scheduled for 02/2026 |
| Depreciable equipment | Cost $48,000; placed in service 01/01/2025; 5-year straight-line life; zero salvage value |

## Proposed entries — 12/31/2025
- Insurance: Debit Insurance Expense $3,000; credit Prepaid Insurance $3,000. Three of twelve coverage months have elapsed.
- Software: Debit Software Expense $600; credit Prepaid Software $600. The full subscription charge is expensed in December.
- Customer advance: Debit Cash $18,000; credit Fabrication Revenue $18,000. Record revenue on receipt because the customer has paid in full.
- Equipment depreciation: Debit Depreciation Expense $8,600; credit Accumulated Depreciation $8,600. Annual straight-line depreciation is cost divided by useful life.

## Close notes
Maria Duarte confirmed the equipment was available for use on 01/01/2025 and no additions or disposals affected the fixed-asset schedule. The customer contract requires delivery before control transfers; no fabrication or delivery occurred by 12/31/2025. The software coverage dates are shown on the vendor invoice, and the payment was recorded to Prepaid Software when paid. Post approved entries to the December general ledger and retain this schedule with the close workpapers.

errors.quote: The full subscription charge is expensed in December.
errors.explanation: The supporting record says the subscription coverage begins 01/01/2026, so none of the service period has elapsed by the 12/31/2025 close. Expensing the full charge in December contradicts those dates and the note that it was recorded as prepaid.
errors.fix: The full subscription charge remains prepaid at December 31.

errors.quote: Record revenue on receipt because the customer has paid in full.
errors.explanation: Under ASC 606, receipt of cash alone does not establish that revenue has been earned. The contract requires delivery before control transfers, and the document says no fabrication or delivery occurred by year-end.
errors.fix: Record the $18,000 as a contract liability on receipt; recognize revenue when control transfers.

errors.quote: Debit Depreciation Expense $8,600; credit Accumulated Depreciation $8,600.
errors.explanation: Straight-line depreciation is ($48,000 cost − $0 salvage value) ÷ 5 years, which equals $9,600, not $8,600.
errors.fix: Debit Depreciation Expense $9,600; credit Accumulated Depreciation $9,600.
